names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 14 octombrie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιοι Ναζάριος, Προτάσιος, Γερβάσιος και Κέλσιος», with the rank word left off; the page's own heading for this one is «Αγιος Ναζαριος».

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1584, «Назарий Римлянин, Медиоланский, мч.», with the rank word left off. It keeps both cities, Rome where he was born and Mediolanum where he died; the day line gives «Назария» alone.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 14. октобар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Назарије, Гервасије и Протасије.“ — «Св.» is "saint" and not a rank and «муч.» is the martyr grade this corpus keeps in `types`, so both come off and the bare personal name, the first of the heading’s three, is the whole of the form; the heading gives none of the three an epithet. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Назарије», so this folder is its only holder and there is no fold to record.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 октября ст. ст. — «Мчч. Назария, Гервасия, Протасия, Келсия (54-68).»
source.note: The rank is the alt text of the icon standing immediately before this line, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all. The day's other icon is «Совершается служба со славословием», the service with the Great Doxology, and it stands immediately before Paraskeva-Petka's line, which is that line's alone and does not reach this one.

attestations.note: The Russian gives the four their only date, Nero's reign, and is the only one of the three calendars with his parentage: the son of the Christian Perpetua and the Jew Africanus, born at Rome and baptised by bishop Linus. It has him leave Rome for Milan deliberately, to preach and to help persecuted Christians; find the twins in the prison there; be beaten and expelled for easing their sufferings; preach in Gaul; and be beheaded with Celsus on Nero's own order after the two of them went back to visit the twins in prison.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 14 octombrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Nazarie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Ναζάριος, Προτάσιος, Γερβάσιος και Κέλσιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same four: Nazarius, whose parents Africanus and Perpetua are said to have been disciples of the Apostle Peter, who met Protasius and Gervasius at Mediolanum and gained Celsus in Gaul, and all four beheaded by the eparch Anoulinos. The page gives no year at all, so no `dates` object is proposed. It records relics: «Τα Λείψανα του Αγίου Προτασίου βρίσκονται στη Ρωμαιοκαθολική Αμβροσιανή Βασιλική του Μιλάνου» and, for Gervasius, «Η Κάρα και τα λοιπά Λείψανα». An apolytikion and a kontakion are taken, both of which name the four together; the Οἶκος and the Κάθισμα are neither a troparion nor a kontakion and are not drafted. **The apolytikion is copied as the page prints it, and the page prints «Λαζάριον» where the sense and the kontakion both have Ναζάριον** — a reading that looks wrong is the source's and is not corrected here. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 27.10.2026 (14. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Назарије, Гервасије и Протасије.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, and the heading is an ENUMERATED COMPANY OF THREE — Назарије, Гервасије and Протасије — so BRIEF-SERBIAN section 5 counts three names, three folders are owed a row, and the corpus holds all three. The heading is quoted whole, with the closing full stop the Prologue prints, which is section 4. The quoted line is the one heading, whole, on all three rows, and the three folders already relate one another. A FOURTH MARTYR IS IN THE BODY AND GETS NO ROW. Келсије — `celsus-disciple-of-nazarius`, a folder this corpus holds and one venerated on this same menologion day in the Russian, Romanian and Greek calendars, and named in the Greek line this folder already quotes — is the young man Nazarius baptised in Gaul, brought back to Milan with him and beheaded beside him. HE IS NOT NAMED IN THIS HEADING, and section 4 and section 5 make the heading the test and not the body, so the Prologue owes him no row. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND IT IS MOSTLY NAZARIUS’S SIDE. He was born at Rome OF A JEWISH FATHER AND A CHRISTIAN MOTHER, and his mother Перпетуа WAS BAPTISED BY THE APOSTLE PETER HIMSELF; he took his mother’s faith. Preaching, he came to Mediolanum, FOUND GERVASIUS AND PROTASIUS ALREADY IN PRISON THERE AND SERVED THEM WITH GREAT LOVE — which is how the three of them come to be one company — and when the local prince learnt of it he had Nazarius beaten and driven out of the city. HIS MOTHER APPEARED TO HIM IN A VISION and told him to go to Gaul and preach the Gospel there, and he did. Years later he came back to Mediolanum with Celsus, whom he had baptised in Gaul, found the two brothers still in prison, and was thrown in with them by a prince the book names Анулин; and the martyrs REJOICED AT THE NEW MEETING BY GOD’S PROVIDENCE. The emperor Нерон ordered Nazarius killed, and he and Celsus were beheaded. GERVASIUS AND PROTASIUS WERE TWINS, and the sons of blessed parents who were disciples of the faith as well, Виталије and Валерија. They were beheaded soon afterwards by a voivode named Астазије who was passing through Mediolanum on his way to a war against the Moravians, and who, hearing that the two brothers would not sacrifice to the idols, FEARED HE WOULD LOSE HIS BATTLE ON THAT ACCOUNT and had them cut down at once. FOUR PEOPLE NAMED AND NONE OF THEM GETS A FOLDER, WHICH IS RULING 3. Перпетуа, Nazarius’s mother: the corpus holds `perpetua-of-carthage`, who is the Carthaginian martyr of 203, and nothing read makes her this Roman woman. Анулин the prince and Астазије the voivode: no folder holds either. Виталије and Валерија, the twins’ parents: the corpus holds `vitalis-the-martyr-23-july`, whose life — READ, not assumed — makes him the armourer of Ravenna who died in 62 encouraging the physician Ursicinus, and `valeria-the-martyr-23-july`, whose folder says in so many words that nothing beyond her Romanian calendar line was read. Neither is identified with these two by anything read here, so no row and no folder, and both are named here instead. `dates` UNTOUCHED ON ALL THREE AND ONE NUMBER REFUSED. The folders hold `death` between 54 and 68, which is Nero’s reign; this entry names «Цар Нерон» and no year at all, and AN EMPEROR IS NOT A SOURCE FOR A YEAR. `types` untouched — «муч.» is the `martyr` all three hold. No `office`, no `locations`: Rome, Mediolanum, Gaul and Ravenna are named and none of them is a coordinate. ONE NEW RECIPROCAL `related` ROW PER FOLDER, AND THE FOLDER IT POINTS AT GETS NO ROW OF ITS OWN. The entry closes on Ambrose: he translated Nazarius’s relics from a garden outside the city into the church of the Holy Apostles, and the relics of Gervasius and Protasius were revealed to him in a wondrous vision. That is read, and it is these martyrs’ story, so `ambrose-of-milan` is a `related` row on each of the three and they are three rows on him — and nothing else is written on his folder, because he is not named in this heading. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day’s verse is Bishop Nikolai’s own and it is on Петка.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Nazarie, Ghervasie, Protasie şi Chelsie

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their struggles received crowns of incorruption from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength they overcame their tormentors, and broke the feeble insolence of the demons also. By their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Τετράριθμον σύνταγμα, τῶν Ἀθλητῶν τοῦ Χριστοῦ, Λαζάριον μέλψωμεν, σὺν Γερβασίω ὁμού, Προτάσιον Κέλσιον οὗτοι γὰρ τὴν Τριάδα, ἀνεκήρυξαν πάσι, λύσαντες δι' ἀγώνων, τὴν πολύθεον πλάνην. Αὐτῶν Χριστὲ ἰκεσίαις, πάντας ἐλέησαν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — the first hymn on the page the four share. It names the company of four and Gervasius, Protasius and Celsus outright; the first name is printed «Λαζάριον» and is copied as printed.

english.text: Let us sing the fourfold company of the champions of Christ — Nazarius with Gervasius together, Protasius and Celsus; for these proclaimed the Trinity to all and undid by their struggles the error of many gods. Christ, at their prayers have mercy on us all.

hymns.text: Μαρτύρωv τοῦ Xριστοῦ, τὴv τετράριθμον δόξαv, ὑμνήσωμεν πιστοί, εὐφημίαις ἀσμάτωv, Ναζάριοv Προτάσιον, καὶ Γερβάσιον Κέλσιον, οὗτοι ἤθλησαν μέχρι τομῆς καὶ θανάτου, οὗτοι στέφαvον, τῆς ἀφθαρσίας λαβόντες, αἰτοῦσι σωθῆναι ἡμᾶς.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος α’, Χορός Ἀγγελικὸς — on the page the four share, and it names all four of them.

english.text: Faithful, let us hymn with the praises of songs the fourfold glory of the Martyrs of Christ — Nazarius, Protasius, Gervasius and Celsus. These contended to the sword and to death; these, having received the crown of incorruption, ask that we be saved.

death.note: Nero's reign, which is the only date any of the three calendars gives the four: days.pravoslavie.ru prints «Мчч. Назария, Гервасия, Протасия, Келсия (54-68)» on the day line and opens its life «пострадали в царствование императора Нерона (54 - 68)». Where a calendar prints a reign rather than a year, that is the interval. Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gives one, and this folder held none.
